patterns: Recurring character is still the only real scale play: lexx_aura's Malfoy clip (Tue 13:44) grew from 337.5K yesterday to 470.5K. Same three-line form (hype line / character line / Seedance 2.5). His own Wed masterpiece one-liner without a named hero stalled at 3.1K. Keep the series hero in line two

Part 2 labeling is the new clone twist: Xmbluee posted 'The father of dragon Part 2' this morning with the short Seedance caption (already 2.1K and climbing). Numbered episodes give a reason to click even when the masterpiece template is tired

Masterpiece one-liner alone is soft: Nely_Brooks crossed 5.6K Wed by adding a story logline under the Seedance line ('smallest adventures / little explorer'). Plain clones (rahat5690, Maviya6v, ArdenAI07) are stuck under 100 views today. Short tool caption + one concrete story beat

Product/tool demos still print views outside the niche: mr_farman_ai CapCut UGC 38.8K (Tue), lexx Black Friday Edit Pilot 20.5K, kingofdairyque Pollo dance 5.3K and biology scoreboard 8.0K (Wed). Useful as timing signals, not as Patrick's format

Patrick: 6 originals in 48h, best 46 (Tue 19:38 Cursed King). This morning Golden Desert Muse at 09:03 already sits at 18 views. Hits on the watchlist still cluster 13:00-20:00 Amsterdam. One post in that window beats another early-morning burst

drafts.text:

The Father of the Dragon 🐉

He climbed the peak where hatchlings sleep,
and swore a vow the dark would keep.
One cracked egg, one roaring cry,
and wings of night tore open the sky.

Made with Grok Imagine 🎬
Want the prompt? Comment FATHER 👇

Poetry by Patrick's Place
drafts.video_tip: 9:16, 10s. Second 0: extreme close-up of a black egg cracking, gold light spilling out. A cloaked man kneels on a cliff as a newborn dragon climbs into his arms. Pull back as both look up and a storm of adult dragons fills the sky. End on the man's eyes matching the hatchling's gold.

drafts.title: 🗡️ THE GIRL WITH THE ASHEN BLADE
drafts.text:
This AI animation is a masterpiece 🔥

A girl, an ashen blade, and one last gate to open 🗡️

She drew the sword the dead had kissed,
and walked the smoke the morning missed.
One swing of grey, the iron broke,
and every locked door turned to smoke.

Made with Grok Imagine 🎬
Want the prompt? Comment BLADE 👇

Poetry by Patrick's Place
drafts.video_tip: 9:16, 10s. Second 0: a pale hand pulls a dull grey sword from a pile of ash, and embers spiral up the blade. Cut to a teenage warrior walking through a burning gate as ash falls like snow. She swings once and the iron bars dissolve into smoke. End on her silhouette against a blood-red sky.
